problem: The explicitly required readiness inputs spacing and span are not constrained anywhere on the ship.
required_change: Add mandatory single-valued length-quantity constraints for nltl:spacing and nltl:span on the ship shape, using metres.
regression_guard: Preserve the existing ship target and metre-unit constraints for length quantities.

problem: The explicitly required UIWL and LIWL inputs are not represented or required; position-type enum values alone do not provide the corresponding waterline reference positions.
required_change: Add mandatory single-valued metre-valued constraints for the canonical upper and lower ice-waterline reference position properties on each direct analysis case, or otherwise require equivalent canonical UIWL and LIWL reference inputs.
regression_guard: Preserve the existing required vertical position types, including the UIWL-centred and half-load-height-below-LIWL cases.
